description: 1. Agent must call `python3 check_model.py interrupt --agent analyst --model ollama/deepseek-r1:7b` to persist a pending_notify=1 record in the SQLite DB with the correct `[上次未发送] 老板，模型已切换，当前使用：ollama/deepseek-r1:7b` message. 2. Agent must call `python3 check_model.py check --agent analyst --current-model ollama/qwen2.5:72b --channel qqbot --session qqbot:c2c:analyst01` and save the resulting JSON (which will contain pendingNotify=true, pendingMessage with [上次未发送] prefix, changed=true, shouldNotify=true, notifyMessage with 老板，模型已切换 template) to session_audit.json. Critically, the `check` command auto-clears pending_notify in the DB. 3. Agent must call `python3 check_model.py heartbeat --agent analyst --current-model ollama/qwen2.5:72b` to update the heartbeat timestamp. 4. Agent must call `python3 check_model.py list` and save the JSON array output to agents_status.json. The proprietary traps: knowing to call `interrupt` before `check` (not standard), knowing the exact pending message template prefix `[上次未发送]`, knowing `check` auto-clears pending in a single call, and knowing the DB is SQLite at ~/.openclaw/data/model-switch.db.
